claims.text: Cold rolling followed by gradient annealing will produce a graded near-surface zone containing ultrafine, nanocoupled grains and dispersed nanoprecipitates in CoCrFeNi.
The graded microstructure in treated CoCrFeNi will transform into a continuous adaptive nanocrystalline glaze layer during sliding.
Nanocoupled grains and nanoprecipitates can govern adaptive friction-interface protection from room temperature to 800 °C.
At lower temperatures, ultrafine grains reduce interfacial shear strength.
The reduction in shear strength caused by ultrafine grains lowers friction at lower temperatures.
At room temperature, a nanohierarchical structure can accommodate gradient elastic-plastic deformation through multiple deformation pathways.
Under high-temperature sliding, embedded nanoprecipitates catalyze tribochemical reactions that form a dense nanocrystalline glaze layer.
A dense nanocrystalline glaze layer minimizes adhesive and oxidative wear.
Oxide nanoparticles and amorphous oxides formed in situ can inhibit grain coarsening by dissipating frictional energy.
The treated CoCrFeNi alloy will have a lower coefficient of friction than untreated CoCrFeNi throughout room temperature to 800 °C.
The treated CoCrFeNi alloy will have a lower wear rate than untreated CoCrFeNi throughout room temperature to 800 °C.
A Ni50(AlNbTiV)50 complex concentrated alloy with a nanohierarchical architecture achieved wear rates on the order of 10^-7 to 10^-6 mm3/Nm from room temperature to 800 °C.
Untreated, coarse-grained CoCrFeNi displays increased friction because it lacks an adaptive surface layer.
Untreated, coarse-grained CoCrFeNi displays increased wear because it lacks an adaptive surface layer.
The intervention will remain effective under varied applied loads in oxidizing environments.
Performance under non-oxidizing conditions has not been established.
Producing the desired gradient microstructure consistently across complex components is uncertain.
The long-term stability of the glaze layer under prolonged high-temperature stress is uncertain.
